newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Four of Dainong Group's 21 units to be bailed out.
newsitem.headline: Four of Dainong Group's 21 units to be bailed out.

text.p: Midopa Department Store Co, Dainong Corp and two more of the Dainong Goup's 21 affiliates have been designated for a bail-out, the group's prime creditor bank said on Monday.
A spokesman for SEOULBANK told Reuters the move was in line with an earlier agreement among major South Korean banks to prevent promising companies from collapsing.
The group's key affiliates have been financially troubled by heavy debts since earnings by its affiliates worsened in line with a cyclical downturn of the economy.
The SEOULBANK spokesman said he could provide no more details. He said details would be announced later on Monday.
Dainong Group officials were not immediately available for comment.
South Korean financial markets have been rocked by a series of corporate failures since early this year, highlighted by the collapses of Hanbo Steel Co in January and Sammi Steel Co.
Most recently, the nation's largest confectioner Samlip General Foods Co filed for court receivership last Thursday under heavy debts.
The 19th-ranked Jinro Group was the first company to benefit from the agreement among banks as six of the group's affiliates have been designated for bail-out.
